'''Robert Martin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th, 2 (−5) at [[July 2000 Huntsville tournament (29 July)]] on 29 July 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal is Getting...]], according to Josh Koziura's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1057">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-huntsville-al-7-29-00d1057/ huntsville-al-7-29-00], DeckTech (Josh "Blue1138" Koziura, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-huntsville-al-7-29-00d1057/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
